title: Clarissa Nada Dahjan
text: Hi readers! My name is Clarissa, I am originally from Indonesia and came to Vancouver in 2019 to do my Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics at UBC. After graduating in 2023, I worked as a Data Analyst and Developer at DarkVision Technologies for 3 years. I am now returning to UBC to join the Master’s of Data Science program (2026-2027), hoping to enhance my hard skills in data science and analysis to be more confident when returning to data-related roles.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
First Day of Classes.


MDS 2026 Cohort 11 began classes on Monday, August 31st 2026! Term 1 begins with 4 courses:

DSCI 511 Programming for Data Science - Programming in Python
DSCI 521 Computing Platforms for Data Science - Git, GitHub, and other Programming Tools
DSCI 523 Programming for Data Manipulation - Programming in R
DSCI 551 Descriptive Statistics and Probability for Data Science

Keeping up so far has been manageable, but they were not kidding about the speed haha. Creating a sustainable routine to balance between the program’s workload and taking breaks will prove to be very important. Super grateful to be part of this program along with so many talented people - first couple of weeks done, just 9 more months to go!

title: About
text: Before joining the Masters of Data Science Program (2026-2027), I worked as a Data Analyst and Developer at DarkVision Technologies. My role involved data cleaning, measuring, analysis, manipulation and processing into various deliverables in forms of Excel, Word Documents, and plots. The main languages I interacted with during these two roles were Matlab and Python, and the occasional SQL code.

title: About
text:
Why Data Science
In the 3 years at DarkVision, I was focused on honing my practical skills on using various Python functionalities to manipulate and process data. Although practical skills are useful, I felt like I was lacking in the theoretical knowledge and the “why” in some design decisions the team made for certain initiatives. Returning back to school for Data Science felt like the right move to take a step back and revisit concepts that I may be familiar with applying, so that it is strengthened with the theories behind them.

Outside of Data Science, I love music, photography, and nature. Some music genre’s I am a fan of include (but are not limited to) indie-folk, alternative-pop, and punk-pop music.
